spots.name: World's Littlest Skyscraper
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Tackett Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 406 m (1,332 ft).

spots.name: Lake Wichita
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. Pin moved to Lake Wichita on the shore.

spots.name: Wichita Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.
